<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?><record_update table="sys_ws_operation"><sys_ws_operation action="INSERT_OR_UPDATE"><active>true</active><consumes>application/json,application/xml,text/xml</consumes><consumes_customized>false</consumes_customized><default_operation_uri/><enforce_acl/><http_method>POST</http_method><name>Create Cyber Incident</name><operation_script><![CDATA[(function process(/*RESTAPIRequest*/ request, /*RESTAPIResponse*/ response) {

    var newCyberInc = request.body.data;
	var myCyberInc = new GlideRecord('x_1776078_cyber_0_cyber_incident');
	myCyberInc.newRecord();
	myCyberInc.setValue('short_description', newCyberInc.short_description);
	myCyberInc.setValue('description', newCyberInc.description);
	myCyberInc.setValue('threat_category', newCyberInc.threat_category);
	myCyberInc.setValue('attack_vector', newCyberInc.attack_vector);
	myCyberInc.setValue('caller_id', newCyberInc.caller_id);
	myCyberInc.setValue('impact', newCyberInc.impact);
	myCyberInc.setValue('urgency', newCyberInc.urgency);
	myCyberInc.insert();
	response.setStatus(201);
	response.setBody({
		sys_id: myCyberInc.sys_id.toString(),
		number: myCyberInc.getValue('number')
	});

})(request, response);]]></operation_script><operation_uri>/api/x_1776078_cyber_0/cyber_incident_api/incident</operation_uri><produces>application/json,application/xml,text/xml</produces><produces_customized>false</produces_customized><relative_path>/incident</relative_path><request_example/><requires_acl_authorization>true</requires_acl_authorization><requires_authentication>true</requires_authentication><requires_snc_internal_role>true</requires_snc_internal_role><short_description/><sys_class_name>sys_ws_operation</sys_class_name><sys_created_by>admin</sys_created_by><sys_created_on>2026-07-28 09:22:05</sys_created_on><sys_id>fbb981a683d2075085257f29feaad3c8</sys_id><sys_mod_count>3</sys_mod_count><sys_name>Create Cyber Incident</sys_name><sys_package display_value="Cyber Incident Management" source="x_1776078_cyber_0">9c0eda15c31d03102d84f44ed4013148</sys_package><sys_policy/><sys_scope display_value="Cyber Incident Management">9c0eda15c31d03102d84f44ed4013148</sys_scope><sys_update_name>sys_ws_operation_fbb981a683d2075085257f29feaad3c8</sys_update_name><sys_updated_by>admin</sys_updated_by><sys_updated_on>2026-07-28 09:41:11</sys_updated_on><web_service_definition display_value="Cyber Incident API">4d0efc6e8352075085257f29feaad38a</web_service_definition><web_service_version/></sys_ws_operation></record_update>
